Given the 100%-missing-ref, single-bulk-load character of this whole scope (per orchestrator notes), this reads as plausible-but-unconfirmed rather than fabricated. Tier reflects that: neither source names the pipeline, so this does not clear the 2-independent-source bar for existence specifically, even though it clears it for 'these two places/entities are real and connectable'.
